    • SPACE_SUIT_CHEST

      public static final io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.SlimefunItemStack SPACE_SUIT_CHEST
      Implementation Note:
      Uses the name/lore constructor deliberately: the trailing SpaceSuit.oxygenLore(int, int) line is a functional marker that SpaceSuit.setOxygen(ItemMeta, int) locates by prefix and live-rewrites as the suit's oxygen changes. Dropping it removes the only lore line the live-update code can match against.
